keyPointsEn: A new self-contained HTML report is generated optionally and is readable in browsers, on phones, and in print.
Quick and deep models can use different providers, e.g., managers on Claude while analysts run on OpenAI.
While analysts work, all overdue logged decisions are settled in the background; failures do not stop the run but are noted.
Crypto sentiment analysis switches to r/CryptoCurrency, r/CryptoMarkets, and coin-specific subreddits.
Fixes address Yahoo news unavailability fallback, Alpha Vantage error handling, and date format issues.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative researchers and open-source practitioners, these changes improve report usability, configuration flexibility across models, and automation of decision tracking, supporting more robust multi-model and historical decision management in backtesting and live analysis workflows.
cards.titleEn: TradingAgents v0.6.0 Released: Adds HTML Reports and Per-Tier Model Providers
cards.summaryEn: Facts: TradingAgents v0.6.0 introduces self-contained HTML reports, per-tier model provider support, runtime decision settlement, crypto Reddit sentiment analysis, Euro-area macro series, and multiple fixes for timeouts, news fetching, and Alpha Vantage error handling. Authors' view: The release notes are descriptive and avoid subjective evaluation of improvements.
cards.limitationsEn: The release notes describe software feature updates and provide no performance benchmarks, backtest results, or accuracy claims; users must independently validate multi-provider configurations, decision settlement logic, and data source fallback behavior and risks in practical settings.
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究者和开源工程实践者而言，这些变更提升了报告可用性、模型配置灵活性以及决策跟踪自动化程度，有助于在回测与实盘分析流程中更稳健地管理多模型与历史决策。
keyPoints: 新增自包含 HTML 报告，可通过参数控制是否生成，且便于浏览器、手机和打印阅读。
支持为快速与深度模型分别设置提供商，例如管理者用 Claude 而分析师用 OpenAI。
在运行分析师时，后台会结算所有已过持有期的历史决策，失败则继续运行并标注。
加密货币情绪分析改用 r/CryptoCurrency、r/CryptoMarkets 及对应币种版块。
修复了 Yahoo 新闻不可用时的回退逻辑、Alpha Vantage 错误处理以及日期格式问题。
cards.title: TradingAgents v0.6.0 发布：新增 HTML 报告与模型分层提供商
cards.summary: 事实：TradingAgents v0.6.0 引入了自包含的 HTML 报告、模型分层提供商支持、运行时决策结算、加密货币 Reddit 情绪分析、欧洲宏观数据系列，以及超时、新闻获取、Alpha Vantage 错误处理等多项修复。作者观点：版本说明以列举变更为主，未对改进效果做主观评价。
cards.descriptionEn: This release adds a self-contained HTML report, per-tier provider configuration for quick and deep models, settlement of due decisions during analyst runs, crypto sentiment analysis on Reddit subreddits, and fixes for Yahoo news fallback logic.
cards.limitations: 版本说明描述的是软件功能更新，未提供性能基准、回测结果或准确性声明；用户需自行验证多提供商配置、决策结算逻辑及数据源回退在实际环境中的行为与风险。
cards.description: 该版本新增可自包含的 HTML 报告、按模型层级（快速/深度）分别指定提供商、分析师运行时结算所有到期决策及加密货币情绪分析扩展至 Reddit 相关子版块，并修复了 Yahoo 新闻源不可用时的回退逻辑。

keyPointsEn: Proposes Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF), which preserves early temporal evidence and adds deeper features only when they temporally agree with earlier representations, avoiding overwriting of early information.
Entire network uses local learning: the first four layers are trained layerwise with unsupervised STDP, and the final classifier uses R-STDP, without global backpropagation.

On Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10, selective multi-depth fusion improves over traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines by 18.2 and 29.2 percentage points, respectively, and remains robust to removal of many late or weak spike events.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This research offers a feasible architecture for spiking neural networks to achieve low-power, online learning on edge devices, mitigating information forgetting in deep networks through local learning rules and temporal fusion, and demonstrating efficient use of event data. The public codebase supports reproducible follow-up research.
cards.titleEn: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion Improves Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
cards.summaryEn: The authors design a multi-depth temporal fusion architecture for feedforward, locally trained spiking neural networks that process static images and event streams. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST report classification performance superior to traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines. Activity-budget analyses show that removing a large fraction of late or weak spike events retains high accuracy, indicating data efficiency.
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on benchmark datasets such as MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST, and are not validated on larger-scale or more complex visual tasks. The performance gains come from comparisons with specific STDP/R-STDP baselines, not with end-to-end backpropagation-trained SNNs or other advanced local learning schemes. The work does not provide quantitative evaluation of energy consumption, latency, or hardware implementation.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为脉冲神经网络在边缘设备上实现低功耗、在线学习提供了一种可行架构，通过局部学习规则和时序融合缓解深层网络中的信息遗忘问题，并展示出对事件数据的高效利用。其公开代码有助于后续可重复研究。
keyPoints: 提出多深度时序融合（MDTF），保留早期时序证据并仅在深层特征与早期表示时间一致时加入，避免早期信息被覆盖。
全网络采用局部学习：前四层无监督STDP逐层训练，最终分类器使用R-STDP，无需全局反向传播。
在Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上，选择性多深度融合比传统STDP/R-STDP基线分别提升18.2和29.2个百分点，且对大量晚期或弱脉冲事件的去除保持鲁棒。
cards.originalTitle: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
cards.title: 多深度时序融合提升脉冲神经网络局部训练性能
cards.summary: 作者设计了一种多深度时序融合架构，用于前馈、局部训练的脉冲神经网络，处理静态图像与事件流。实验在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和N-MNIST上进行，报告了优于传统STDP/R-STDP基线的分类性能。活动预算分析表明，去除大量后期或弱脉冲事件后仍能保持较高准确率，体现数据效率。
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes a Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion mechanism in a four-layer convolutional spiking neural network, combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation while all layers are trained locally and online via unsupervised STDP and R-STDP. It reports improvements of 18.2 and 29.2 percentage points over traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines on Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10, respectively, and demonstrates data efficiency by retaining accuracy when many spik
cards.limitations: 结果基于MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和N-MNIST等基准数据集，未验证更大规模或更复杂视觉任务。性能提升来自与特定STDP/R-STDP基线的比较，未与端到端反向传播训练的SNN或其他先进局部学习方案对比。该工作未涉及能耗、延迟或硬件实现的定量评估。
cards.description: 该工作提出多深度时序融合机制，在四层卷积脉冲神经网络中结合残差式连接与多深度特征聚合，所有层均采用无监督STDP和R-STDP进行局部、在线训练。在Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上，该方法相比传统STDP/R-STDP基线分别提升18.2和29.2个百分点，并展示出对稀疏事件去除的数据效率。

keyPointsEn: Using only routine weather sequences plus two lightweight static inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label), the framework forecasts national Brazilian soybean yield across 20 seasons; the Transformer achieves RMSE 149 kg/ha, rRMSE 5.3%, and R² = 0.784.

All deep learning variants outperform ridge regression and all sequential encoders outperform the non-sequential MLP; in-season forecasts improve monotonically from early to late issuance, with the latest forecast point showing roughly 50% lower error than the farmer baseline.

Ablations show the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity; SHAP suggests crop year explains the long-run trajectory while within-season weather and agro-environmental context explain interannual deviations.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Reliable and timely crop-yield forecasts matter for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. This framework indicates that, in the specific Brazilian soybean case, competitive accuracy can be obtained from routine weather plus a few static context inputs, while supporting different sequence encoders under identical data requirements, offering a testable low-cost path for operational monitoring and transfer to other crops and regions where data resources are limited.
cards.titleEn: Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Brazilian Soybean Yield Forecasting
cards.summaryEn: Facts: the paper uses 20 Brazilian soybean seasons (2001/02–2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, comparing MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, Transformer, and Mamba state-space models against ridge regression and a five-year moving-average 'farmer' baseline. Facts: all deep learning variants outperform ridge, all sequential encoders outperform the non-sequential MLP; the Transformer reaches national RMSE 149 kg/ha, rRMSE 5.3%, R² = 0.784, cuts error by 47.6% versus the farmer baseline, and in-season forecast error decreases monotonically from early to late issuance. Author view: the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts; SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains the long-run trajectory while within-season weather and agro-environmental context drive interannual deviations, but these interpretations are model-based inferences.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence boundary is explicit: conclusions rest on a single-country case of 20 Brazilian soybean seasons (2001/02–2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, and no independent validation on other crops or regions is reported. Model comparisons are limited to MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, Transformer, and Mamba, against ridge regression and a five-year moving-average baseline, not all possible forecasting methods. The accuracy figures (RMSE 149 kg/ha, rRMSE 5.3%, R² = 0.784) and the 47.6% error reduction are case-specific and should not be generalized as guaranteed. SHAP diagnostics reflect internal model attribution rather than causal mechanisms, and causal roles of crop year, weather, and the agro-environmental label require further experimental validation. Robustness under extreme weather, policy shifts, pests, or abrupt data-quality changes, as well as real-world deployment costs and error assessments, are not addressed.
cards.whyItMatters: 可靠且及时的作物产量预测对市场稳定与风险管理很重要，但许多方法依赖昂贵或难以规模化的输入。该框架表明，在特定巴西大豆案例中，仅靠常规天气和少量静态背景即可获得有竞争力的预测精度，并支持在相同数据要求下替换多种序列编码器，这为数据资源有限地区的业务化监测和跨作物、跨区域迁移提供了可检验的低成本路径。
keyPoints: 仅使用常规天气序列与作物年份、农业环境标签两个轻量静态输入，即可在巴西大豆20季案例中实现全国产量预测，Transformer达到RMSE 149 kg/ha、rRMSE 5.3%、R²=0.784。
所有深度学习变体优于岭回归，所有序列编码器优于非序列MLP；季内预测从早季到晚季误差单调下降，最新预测点误差约为农民基线的50%。
消融显示农业环境标签与空间实例扩展（同一市镇-年份多条网格天气序列）正向贡献且不增加输入复杂度；SHAP提示作物年份解释长期轨迹，季内天气和农业环境背景解释年际偏差。
cards.originalTitle: An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean
cards.title: 仅用常规天气数据的巴西大豆产量预测框架
cards.summary: 事实：论文使用2001/02至2020/21共20个巴西大豆生长季、留一年交叉验证，比较MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer和Mamba状态空间模型，以线性岭回归和五年移动平均“农民”基线为对照。事实：所有深度学习变体优于岭回归，所有序列编码器优于非序列MLP；Transformer全国精度RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784，较农民基线误差降低47.6%，且季内预测误差随发布时间推移单调下降。作者观点：该框架可直接部署到其他作物和地理区域，并天然兼容业务天气预报；SHAP诊断解释作物年份主导长期轨迹，季内天气和农业环境背景主导年际偏差，但上述解释属于作者基于模型诊断的推断。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label). In a 20-season Brazilian soybean case, a Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg/ha; rRMSE 5.3%; R² = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to a five-year moving-average baseline. Its novelty lies in supporting multipl
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：结论仅基于巴西大豆2001/02至2020/21共20个生长季的单一国家案例，采用留一年交叉验证，未在文中展示其他作物或地理区域的独立验证结果。模型比较限于MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer和Mamba，基线为线性岭回归与五年移动平均，未涵盖所有可能的预测方法。精度指标（RMSE 149 kg/ha、rRMSE 5.3%、R²=0.784）与47.6%误差降幅均为该案例特定结果，不能直接外推为普遍保证。SHAP诊断反映模型内部分配而非因果机制，作物年份、天气与农业环境标签的因果作用需进一步实验验证。文本未说明极端天气、政策变化、病虫害或数据质量突变情形下的稳健性，也未提供实际业务部署的成本与误差评估。
cards.description: 该研究提出一种输入节俭、可迁移且与架构无关的深度学习框架，仅以常规天气为随时间变化输入，辅以作物年份和农业环境标签两个静态背景输入，在巴西大豆20个生长季案例中，Transformer 达到全国最优精度（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较五年移动平均基线误差降低47.6%。其新意在于以极低输入复杂度支撑多种序列编码器，并证明农业环境标签与空间实例扩展可提升精度而不增加输入负担；对业务化作物监测具有直接参考价值。

keyPointsEn: Seed-Q assigns larger representation budgets to sensitive weights and compresses less sensitive regions more aggressively, with no per-block metadata or calibration data needed.
The paper reports that at the same 4 bits per weight, Seed-Q reduces perplexity degradation and zero-shot accuracy loss relative to SeedLM.
Because bit corruption affects multiple reconstructed weights, Seed-Q shows higher security against parameter bit-flip attacks and easier detection, and is implemented in an ASIC-based accelerator.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the reported results hold, the method could mitigate both accuracy loss from compression and parameter bit-flip risk without significant storage or hardware overhead, offering reference value for deployment-side LLM compression and security protection.
cards.titleEn: Seed-Based Weight Quantization Balances Sensitivity and Security
cards.summaryEn: Storage, memory-bandwidth, and energy costs of large language models motivate compact weight representations. Existing seed-based compression reconstructs weights from pseudo-random representations but does not explicitly account for non-uniform weight sensitivity. The authors propose Seed-Q, which uses lightweight LFSR-based weight generation with non-uniform bit allocation and reports matching SeedLM's 4-bit perplexity with fewer bits across diverse LLMs.
cards.limitationsEn: The reported effects come from the paper's specific models and experimental settings; the original text does not establish applicability across all model scales, tasks, and attack scenarios. The scope of bit-flip security evaluation and absolute ASIC overhead should be judged from the original data, and practical deployment gains still require independent reproduction.
cards.whyItMatters: 若结论成立，该方法可在不显著增加存储与硬件开销的前提下，同时缓解模型压缩带来的精度损失与参数比特翻转风险，对部署端的大模型压缩与安全防护具有参考价值。
keyPoints: Seed-Q 对敏感权重分配更大表示预算，对不敏感区域更激进压缩，且分配方案无需存储逐块元数据或校准数据。
论文报告在相同 4 比特/权重下，Seed-Q 相对 SeedLM 降低困惑度退化与零样本精度损失。
由于比特损坏会影响多个重建权重，Seed-Q 对参数比特翻转攻击表现出更高安全性与更易检测性，并已在 ASIC 加速器上实现。
cards.originalTitle: Security-Enhanced Seed-Based Weight Quantization for Large Language Models
cards.title: 种子式权重量化兼顾灵敏度与安全性
cards.summary: 大型语言模型的存储、内存带宽与能耗开销推动紧凑权重表示研究。既有种子式压缩从伪随机表示重建权重，但未显式考虑权重灵敏度的不均匀性。作者提出 Seed-Q，采用轻量 LFSR 权重生成与非均匀比特分配，并报告在多种模型上以更少比特匹配 SeedLM 的 4 比特困惑度。
cards.descriptionEn: Seed-Q introduces sensitivity-aware non-uniform bit allocation into seed-based weight compression, letting the decoder deterministically reconstruct the allocation without side information, improving perplexity and zero-shot accuracy without extra stored metadata while enhancing detectability of parameter bit-flip attacks.
cards.limitations: 上述效果来自论文在特定模型与实验设置下的报告，原文未说明所有模型规模、任务与攻击场景均适用；比特翻转安全性的评估范围与 ASIC 开销的绝对量级需以原文数据为准，实际部署收益仍待独立复现。
cards.description: Seed-Q 在种子式权重压缩中引入灵敏度感知的非均匀比特分配，无需侧信息即可由解码器确定性重建分配方案，在不增加存储元数据的前提下改善困惑度与零样本精度，并提升对参数比特翻转攻击的检测性。

keyPointsEn: The benchmark covers 136 experimental configurations and 17,688 document-level inferences with deterministic decoding across five 2B-8B instruction-tuned open-weight models, three datasets, and four text-quality conditions.

Evaluation separates Key Recall (annotated-field recovery), Exact Match, and Value F1 (exact and partial value recovery) to test whether OCR degradation affects field identification and value reproduction differently.

The findings challenge three practical assumptions: clean-text performance predicts real-world robustness, model rankings remain consistent across annotation-derived Gold and OCR-derived text, and additional few-shot demonstrations monotonically improve extraction accuracy.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Isolating and auditing errors in modular OCR-to-LLM pipelines helps clarify reliability risks in real document processing; model-ranking reversals and unstable few-shot gains suggest that selecting models based only on clean text or a few demonstrations may mislead deployment and evaluation conclusions.
cards.titleEn: Benchmarking LLM-Driven Key-Value Extraction in Noisy Document Settings
cards.summaryEn: The study introduces a controlled benchmark that distinguishes upstream OCR degradation from downstream LLM extraction behavior, covering five instruction-tuned open-weight models (2B-8B), three datasets, and four text-quality conditions. Factually, the evaluation combines zero-shot comparisons, one- to three-shot experiments, and a sensitivity analysis of 40 configurations across 20 frozen demonstration sets, and separates Key Recall, Exact Match, and Value F1. The authors argue that clean-text performance does not reliably predict real-world robustness, model rankings can reverse between annotation-derived Gold text and OCR-derived text, and additional few-shot demonstrations do not monotonically improve extraction accuracy.
cards.limitationsEn: The input only provides the benchmark design, configuration scale, and conclusion directions, without specific metric values, significance tests, or confidence intervals across models, datasets, and text-quality conditions. The benchmark is limited to five 2B-8B instruction-tuned open-weight models, three datasets, and four text-quality conditions; extrapolation to other models, languages, document types, or OCR systems requires additional validation. The few-shot sensitivity analysis is based on 20 frozen demonstration sets and 40 configurations, and cannot cover all demonstration-selection strategies.
cards.whyItMatters: 模块化OCR到LLM流程中的误差可被隔离和审计，有助于理解真实文档处理流水线的可靠性风险；模型排名反转和少样本增益不稳定提示，仅凭干净文本或少量演示选择模型可能误导部署与评测结论。
keyPoints: 基准覆盖136种实验配置、17688次文档级确定性解码推理，涉及五个2B-8B指令微调开放权重模型、三个数据集和四种文本质量条件。
评测将关键召回（标注字段恢复）、精确匹配和值F1（精确与部分值恢复）分开，以检验OCR退化对字段识别和值复现的影响是否不同。
结果挑战三种实用假设：干净文本性能可预测真实稳健性、模型排名在标注金标准与OCR文本间保持一致、增加少样本演示单调提升准确率。
cards.originalTitle: From Pixels to Pairs: A Comprehensive Benchmark of LLM-Driven Key-Value Extraction in Noisy Document Settings
cards.title: 面向含噪文档的LLM键值抽取基准评测
cards.summary: 研究提出一个受控基准，用于区分上游OCR退化与下游LLM抽取行为，覆盖五个指令微调开放权重模型（2B-8B）、三个数据集和四种文本质量条件。事实层面：评测组合了零样本对比、一至三样本实验，以及20组冻结演示集上的40种配置敏感性分析，并按关键召回、精确匹配和值F1拆分评估。作者观点：干净文本性能不能可靠预测真实场景稳健性，模型在标注金标准与OCR文本上的排名可能反转，追加少样本演示未必单调提升抽取准确率。
cards.descriptionEn: This benchmark separates OCR degradation from downstream LLM extraction and evaluates 136 configurations and 17,688 document-level inferences to test the robustness of key-value pair extraction under noisy text, exposing failure boundaries in three common assumptions about clean-text performance, model rankings, and few-shot gains.
cards.limitations: 输入材料仅给出基准设计、配置规模和结论方向，未提供各模型、数据集与文本质量条件下的具体指标数值、显著性检验或置信区间。基准限定于五个2B-8B指令微调开放权重模型、三个数据集和四种文本质量条件，结论向其他模型、语言、文档类型或OCR系统的外推需要额外验证。少样本敏感性分析基于20组冻结演示集和40种配置，不能覆盖所有演示选择策略。
cards.description: 该基准将OCR退化与下游LLM抽取过程分离评估，覆盖136种配置和17688次文档级推理，用于检验键值与成对字段抽取在含噪文本下的稳健性，并揭示干净文本表现、模型排名和少样本增益三类常见假设的失效边界。

keyPointsEn: The ÍTM SignWiki dataset has only 1,845 videos and 849 classes, with 86% of classes containing just two examples, approximating one-shot recognition.
With ÍTM data alone, SPOTER outperforms OpenHands on all three tasks, and MediaPipe poses give the best results among pose estimators.
American Sign Language pretraining improves SPOTER by 14–24 percentage points, and multilingual training raises OpenHands from 1.41% to 28.86% on the full task.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides baseline experiments and evidence for cross-lingual transfer in extremely low-resource sign language recognition, showing that transfer from better-resourced sign languages can substantially improve performance for low-resource ones, and releases adapted frameworks to support further research.
cards.titleEn: Low-Resource Isolated Sign Language Recognition for Icelandic Sign Language with Cross-Lingual Transfer
cards.summaryEn: This paper presents the first isolated sign language recognition experiments for Icelandic Sign Language, using the ÍTM SignWiki dataset derived from a bilingual online dictionary, which contains only 1,845 videos covering 849 classes, with 86% of classes having just two examples, effectively making it a one-shot recognition task across signers. The authors compare OpenHands and SPOTER on three tasks with 22, 117, and 849 classes, and evaluate three pose estimators and two forms of cross-lingual transfer. They report that with ÍTM data alone, SPOTER outperforms OpenHands, and MediaPipe poses yield better results than AlphaPose or SDPose; cross-lingual transfer brings the largest gains, with American Sign Language pretraining improving SPOTER by 14–24 percentage points, and multilingual training lifting OpenHands from 1.41% to 28.86% on the full task.
cards.limitationsEn: Performance remains far from practical use, with the best full-task accuracy at only 28.86%; the dataset is small with very few examples per class, so generalization of cross-lingual transfer needs validation across more sign languages and larger data; experiments are limited to two frameworks and three pose estimators, constraining the scope of conclusions.
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为极端低资源手语识别提供了基线实验和跨语言迁移证据，表明从资源丰富手语迁移可显著改善低资源手语识别性能，并公开了适配后的框架，有助于后续研究。
keyPoints: ÍTM SignWiki数据集仅1845个视频、849个类别，86%类别只有两个样本，任务接近一次性识别。
仅用ÍTM数据时，SPOTER在三个任务上均优于OpenHands，MediaPipe姿态估计结果最佳。
美国手语预训练后微调使SPOTER精度提升14–24个百分点，多语言训练将OpenHands全任务精度从1.41%提升至28.86%。
cards.originalTitle: Isolated Sign Language Recognition for Icelandic Sign Language: Experiments in a Low-resource Setting
cards.title: 冰岛手语孤立词识别低资源实验与跨语言迁移
cards.summary: 论文首次在冰岛手语上开展孤立手语识别实验，使用来自双语在线词典的ÍTM SignWiki数据集，该数据集仅1845个视频覆盖849个类别，86%类别仅有两个样本，实质为跨签名者的一次性识别。实验比较OpenHands和SPOTER在22、117和849类三个任务上的表现，并评估三种姿态估计器和两种跨语言迁移形式。作者报告称，仅用ÍTM数据时SPOTER优于OpenHands，MediaPipe姿态估计优于AlphaPose和SDPose；跨语言迁移增益最大，美国手语预训练后微调提升14–24个百分点，多语言训练将OpenHands全任务精度从1.41%提升至28.86%。
cards.descriptionEn: First experiments on isolated sign language recognition for Icelandic Sign Language (ÍTM) under extreme low-resource conditions, using a dataset of 1,845 videos across 849 classes with 86% of classes having only two examples. The study compares OpenHands and SPOTER frameworks, multiple pose estimators, and cross-lingual transfer strategies, finding that transfer from better-resourced sign languages yields the largest accuracy gains.
cards.limitations: 结果仍远未达到实际应用水平，全任务最高精度仅28.86%；数据集规模小且类别样本极少，跨语言迁移的泛化性需在更多手语和更大数据上验证；实验仅比较两种框架和三种姿态估计器，结论范围有限。
cards.description: 首次针对冰岛手语（ÍTM）开展孤立手语识别实验，在仅1845个视频、849个类别且86%类别仅两个样本的极端低资源条件下，比较OpenHands与SPOTER框架及多种姿态估计器和跨语言迁移策略，发现从美国手语等资源丰富语言迁移可带来最大精度提升。

keyPointsEn: KaliBench covers 8,504 query-command pairs, 1,642 tools, 23 capability dimensions, and 5 security phases for fine-grained evaluation of natural-language-to-Kali-Linux-CLI translation.

Evaluation uses alias-aware and deterministic canonicalization and supports runtime-free verifiable rewards; the dataset construction combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement.

The authors report that in the unrestricted setting no open-weight model among 24 configurations exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy, and that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from this benchmark improve an 8B model to performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces, where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag-value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution; directly measuring command-level executability enables evaluations closer to real workflows and provides verifiable reward signals for training.
cards.titleEn: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
cards.summaryEn: The paper introduces KaliBench for fine-grained evaluation of natural-language-to-CLI translation on Kali Linux, with 8,504 query-command pairs covering 1,642 tools, 23 capability dimensions, and 5 security phases. The authors state that the benchmark is built via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, and that a multi-stage verification pipeline (LLM validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement) is used to target both semantic correctness and practical executability. The authors report that across 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, and that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model to performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence boundary is as stated by the paper: the benchmark and conclusions mainly come from the authors' KaliBench dataset and its evaluation pipeline, and the abstract does not provide systematic validation of cross-dataset generalization, real production deployment effects, or long-term security risks; the model accuracy and training gains are author-reported values without full statistical uncertainty and reproduction details in the abstract; independently evaluating misuse and security compliance risks remains necessary when using related rewards for training or deployment.
cards.whyItMatters: 网络安全操作依赖严格的命令行接口，细微的语法、标志—取值绑定或参数顺序错误都会导致执行失败；直接测量命令级可执行性，有助于更贴近真实工作流地评估模型，并为训练阶段提供可验证的奖励信号。
keyPoints: KaliBench 覆盖 8504 条查询—命令对、1642 个工具、23 个能力维度与 5 个安全阶段，面向自然语言到 Kali Linux CLI 的细粒度翻译评测。
评测采用别名感知与确定性规范化，并支持无需运行时即可验证的奖励；数据构建含 LLM 校验、沙箱执行与人工迭代。
作者报告在非受限设置下，24 种开源权重模型配置中无一精确命令准确率超过 42%；并称基于该基准的监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习可提升 8B 模型至接近 685B MoE 的表现。
cards.originalTitle: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
cards.title: KaliBench：面向 Kali Linux 网络安全工具命令生成的细粒度基准
cards.summary: 论文提出 KaliBench，用于细粒度评估自然语言到 Kali Linux 命令行的翻译能力，数据规模为 8504 条查询—命令对，覆盖 1642 个工具、23 个能力维度与 5 个安全阶段。作者称评测集通过基于手稿的流程构建，结合确定性规范化与别名感知评估，并用多阶段验证（LLM 校验、沙箱终端执行、人工迭代）兼顾语义正确与可执行性。作者报告在受限/非受限等评测设置下，24 种通用与安全向开源权重模型配置中无一在非受限设置下精确命令准确率超过 42%，并称用 KaliBench 派生奖励做监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习可显著提升 8B 模型，达到接近 685B MoE 模型的表现。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing evaluations mostly focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to turn analyst intent into executable commands for real cybersecurity tools. KaliBench provides 8,504 query-command pairs spanning 1,642 tools, 23 capability dimensions, and 5 security phases, with alias-aware and deterministic canonicalization for evaluation and runtime-free verifiable rewards.
cards.limitations: 证据边界以论文自述为准：基准与结论主要来自作者构建的 KaliBench 数据集及其评测流程，摘要未给出跨数据集泛化、真实生产环境部署效果或长期安全风险的系统验证；模型准确率与训练收益均为作者报告值，未在摘要中提供完整统计不确定性与复现细节；将相关奖励用于训练或部署时仍需独立评估误用与安全合规风险。
cards.description: 现有评测多聚焦知识问答或端到端智能体任务，未直接衡量大模型把分析师意图转成真实网络安全工具可执行命令行（CLI）的能力。KaliBench 提供 8504 条“自然语言—命令”配对，覆盖 1642 个工具、23 个能力维度与 5 个安全阶段，并采用别名感知与确定性规范化评测，支持无需运行时即可验证的奖励信号。

Its self-description calls it a next-generation e2e testing framework, emphasizing a generational update.

keyPointsEn: Formalizes smart contract-mediated resource allocation as a contract-clearing game under shared capacity constraints and establishes equilibrium existence and uniqueness.
Proposes a decentralized price-adjustment algorithm with provable convergence for real-time operation.
Evaluates the mechanism through synthetic simulations and a long-horizon analysis using financial and macroeconomic data from 2006 to 2025.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the equilibrium and convergence properties hold, the framework can provide an economic design foundation for decentralized resource coordination that balances efficiency, fairness, and resilience, reducing reliance on ad-hoc heuristics or purely technical blockchain implementations and offering an analyzable basis for real-time operation and shock recovery.
cards.titleEn: Mechanism Design and Equilibrium Analysis of Smart Contract-Mediated Resource Allocation
cards.summaryEn: The study models smart contract-mediated resource allocation as a contract-clearing game under shared capacity constraints, establishes the existence and uniqueness of equilibrium, and proposes a decentralized price-adjustment algorithm with provable convergence suitable for real-time operation. The authors report that, in synthetic simulations and a representative real-world dataset, the mechanism reduces inequality and cost while maintaining near-optimal efficiency and rapid recovery after shocks. A long-horizon empirical analysis using financial and macroeconomic data from 2006 to 2025 indicates dynamic stability beyond steady state across major economic regimes and shock conditions.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes mainly from theoretical modeling, synthetic simulations, and validation on specific real-world data; the practical applicability of equilibrium existence, uniqueness, and convergence depends on model assumptions and conditions such as shared capacity constraints. The 2006–2025 macroeconomic and financial data serve as a representative long-horizon check and cannot be directly extrapolated as universal conclusions for all industrial systems or asset markets, nor does this constitute investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该框架的均衡与收敛性质成立，可为去中心化资源协调提供兼顾效率、公平与韧性的经济设计基础，减少对临时启发式或纯技术区块链实现的依赖，并为实时运行和冲击恢复提供可分析依据。
keyPoints: 将智能合约资源分配形式化为共享容量约束下的合约清算博弈，并证明均衡存在且唯一。
提出具收敛保证的去中心化价格调整算法，面向实时运行场景。
通过合成仿真和2006至2025年金融与宏观数据的长周期分析评估机制表现。
cards.originalTitle: Mechanism design and equilibrium analysis of smart contract-mediated resource allocation
cards.title: 智能合约资源分配的机制设计与均衡分析
cards.summary: 研究把智能合约资源分配建模为共享容量约束下的合约清算博弈，证明均衡存在且唯一，并提出可实时运行、具收敛保证的去中心化价格调整算法。作者报告在合成仿真与代表性真实数据中，该机制在保持近优效率的同时降低不平等和成本，并在冲击后快速恢复。基于2006至2025年金融与宏观数据的长周期分析显示，其在主要经济状态与冲击条件下具有超越稳态的动态稳定性。
cards.descriptionEn: Addressing the lack of rigorous economic foundations in decentralized coordination, this study proposes a mechanism-design framework that jointly embeds efficiency, fairness, and resilience in smart contract-mediated resource allocation, and examines its performance through theory, simulations, and data from 2006 to 2025.
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自理论建模、合成仿真与特定真实数据验证，其均衡存在唯一性与收敛性的实际适用性取决于模型假设和共享容量约束等条件；2006至2025年的宏观与金融数据属代表性长周期检验，不能直接外推为所有工业系统或资产市场的普遍结论，也不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究针对去中心化协调中缺乏严谨经济基础的问题，提出一种将效率、公平性与韧性共同嵌入智能合约资源分配的机制设计框架，并通过理论与仿真及2006至2025年数据检验其表现。

keyPointsEn: The variance correction centers and rescales each draw over a fixed horizon before adding the market factor, avoiding a second generator fitted to regression residuals.

Across 423 non-market assets, corrected paths retain heavy tails and recover calibrated market loadings with low error; on 416 complete assets held out from 2025, they improve KS pass rates and bring the median variance ratio close to one.

A jump-duration mechanism improves SPY volatility clustering, but transferring SPY jump settings worsens temporal fit in the holdout; the one-day left-tail 99% VaR exceedance rate is 1.12% versus 1.16% for the residual-fit hidden Markov comparator.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an actionable correction for reusing already-fitted asset generators in quantitative research, supporting daily-fit comparisons and multi-asset stress testing, while warning that residual dependence and terminal uncertainty can affect rebalancing-return estimates.
cards.titleEn: Variance-Corrected Multi-Asset Equity Simulation with Hybrid Hidden Markov Marginals
cards.summaryEn: The study proposes a variance correction for synthetic multi-asset return data, addressing the double-counting of market variance when draws from an already-fitted asset generator are added directly to a market factor. Tests on a 424-asset U.S. equity and ETF universe with hidden Markov heavy-tailed generators show that corrected paths retain heavy tails and recover calibrated market loadings; on 416 complete asset histories held out from 2025, the correction improves KS pass rates and brings the median synthetic-to-observed variance ratio close to one. The authors also test a jump-duration mechanism and SPY parameter transfer, and note limitations including the zero-sum residual constraint and unmodeled residual dependence.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a 424-asset U.S. equity and ETF sample and a 2025 holdout, and performance depends on the hidden Markov heavy-tailed generators and market-factor specification; the zero-sum residual constraint removes terminal residual uncertainty, but unmodeled asset-specific residual dependence can lead to overstated rebalancing returns; SPY jump-setting transfer performs inconsistently between training and holdout.
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化研究中复用已拟合的资产生成器提供了可操作的校正路径，便于日常拟合比较和多资产压力测试，同时提醒残差依赖与终端不确定性可能影响再平衡收益估计。
keyPoints: 方差校正通过固定时段中心化与重缩放每笔抽样，再叠加市场因子，避免重复拟合残差生成器。
在423个非市场资产上，校正路径保留重尾、低误差恢复校准市场载荷，并在2025留出416个完整资产上提升KS通过率、使方差比中位数接近1。
跳跃持续时间机制改善SPY波动聚集，但SPY跳跃设置迁移到留出集后时序拟合变差；一日左尾99% VaR超限率为1.12%，残差拟合隐马尔可夫对照为1.16%。
cards.originalTitle: Variance-Corrected Multi-Asset Equity Simulation with Hybrid Hidden Markov Marginals
cards.title: 方差校正多资产模拟：混合隐马尔可夫边际方法
cards.summary: 该研究针对合成多资产收益数据提出方差校正，解决将已拟合资产生成器的抽样直接叠加市场因子导致市场方差被重复计入的问题。作者在424资产美股与ETF池中测试了隐马尔可夫重尾生成器，校正路径保留了重尾并恢复市场载荷；在416个2025年留出资产上，校正提升了KS通过率并让合成/观测方差比中位数接近1。作者还测试了跳跃持续时间机制及SPY参数迁移，并指出零和残差约束和残差依赖未建模等局限。
cards.descriptionEn: Presents a variance correction that allows already-fitted asset-return generators to be reused in multi-asset scenario construction without fitting a second generator to regression residuals, validated on 423 U.S. equities and ETFs for distribution and tail-fit improvements.
cards.limitations: 证据基于424资产美股与ETF样本及2025年留出集，方法表现依赖隐马尔可夫重尾生成器和市场因子设定；零和残差约束消除了终端残差不确定性，但未建模的资产特有残差依赖可能导致再平衡收益被高估；SPY跳跃设置迁移在训练与留出集表现不一致。
cards.description: 提出一种方差校正方法，使已拟合的资产收益生成器可直接用于多资产情景构建，无需为回归残差再拟合第二生成器，并以423只美股与ETF验证其分布与尾部拟合改善。

keyPointsEn: The extended state-dependent Hawkes process allows state disappearances and proves separable maximum likelihood estimation via KKT conditions, preserving an efficient two-step procedure.
On real high-frequency data, it reproduces the upward slope of the volatility signature plot and attributes local super-criticality to disequilibrium states.
Aggressive market orders deterministically trigger transitions out of equilibrium, while marketable limit orders act as a liquidity-depletion catalyst within the expanded spread.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work suggests that physical consistency constraints are necessary for high-frequency volatility modeling and simulation stability: unconstrained standard state-dependent Hawkes models exhibit explosive spectral radii and structural bias, whereas ExsdHawkes pauses residual accumulation during inadmissible periods and maintains statistical integrity and simulation stability.
cards.titleEn: Extended State-dependent Hawkes Process for Limit Order Books: Modeling and Reproduction of Volatility Signature Plots
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes an Extended State-Dependent Hawkes Process (ExsdHawkes) that allows state disappearances in limit order books and proves separable maximum likelihood estimation using KKT conditions. Empirically, the model reproduces the upward slope of the volatility signature plot, explains local super-criticality as a disequilibrium phenomenon, and identifies aggressive market orders as deterministic triggers of transitions out of equilibrium and marketable limit orders as a liquidity-depletion catalyst. The author argues that physical consistency is a prerequisite for accurately modeling macro-level volatility, while models without physical constraints suffer from explosive spectral radii and simulation instability.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on three months of high-frequency data for a single asset (Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group 8306); the reproduction of the volatility signature plot and the super-criticality interpretation depend on this dataset; no robustness checks across assets, markets, or longer samples are provided; the findings do not constitute investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明物理一致性约束对高频波动率建模和模拟稳定性是必要的：无约束的标准状态依赖Hawkes模型会出现谱半径爆炸和结构偏差，而ExsdHawkes通过暂停不可接受时期的残差累积，保持了统计完整性和模拟稳定性。
keyPoints: 允许状态消失的扩展状态依赖Hawkes过程，通过KKT条件证明最大似然估计可分离，保持两步估计效率。
在真实高频数据上复现波动率特征图的上行斜率，将局部超临界性归因于非均衡状态。
激进市价单确定性触发非均衡转换，可成交限价单在扩大价差中充当流动性消耗催化剂。
cards.originalTitle: Extended State-dependent Hawkes Process for Limit Order Books: Mathematical Foundation and the Reproduction of Volatility Signature Plots
cards.title: 状态依赖Hawkes过程扩展用于限价订单簿建模与波动率特征图再现
cards.summary: 论文提出扩展状态依赖Hawkes过程（ExsdHawkes），允许限价订单簿中的状态消失，并用KKT条件证明最大似然估计可分离。实证中模型复现了波动率特征图的上行斜率，将局部超临界性解释为非均衡状态下的现象，且指出激进市价单触发非均衡转换，可成交限价单充当流动性消耗催化剂。作者观点认为物理一致性是准确建模宏观波动率的先决条件，缺乏物理约束的模型会出现谱半径爆炸和模拟不稳定。
cards.descriptionEn: The study relaxes the traditional state-persistence constraint in state-dependent Hawkes processes by allowing state disappearances common in high-frequency trading, and proves that maximum likelihood estimation remains separable with an efficient two-step procedure. Using three months of high-frequency tick data for Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, the model reproduces the upward slope of the volatility signature plot and attributes local super-criticality to disequilibrium s
cards.limitations: 证据基于单一标的（三菱日联金融集团8306）三个月高频数据；波动率特征图复现与超临界性解释依赖该数据集；未提供跨资产、跨市场或更长样本的稳健性检验；结论不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究放松了传统状态依赖Hawkes过程对状态持续存在的约束，允许高频交易中常见的状态消失现象，并证明最大似然估计仍可分离、可用两步法高效计算。基于三菱日联金融集团三个月高频逐笔数据，模型成功复现波动率特征图的上行斜率，并将局部超临界性归因于非均衡状态，其中激进市价单确定性触发非均衡转换，可成交限价单充当流动性消耗催化剂。

keyPointsEn: Symmetric losses penalize models with genuine but noisy directional skill because the conditional mean of financial log-returns is near zero, causing predictions to shrink during training and trivial zero forecasters to dominate loss-based rankings during evaluation.

CZAR is a piecewise quadratic loss that is convex in the prediction at a fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults.

Under a Gaussian linear model, the breakeven directional accuracy for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise, whereas the threshold under CZAR evaluation remains near 50%, and this advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions and in a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides an objective function more aligned with economic goals for financial return prediction, helping reduce model shrinkage toward zero and preventing the zero predictor from achieving inflated rankings under symmetric losses. For quantitative research, CZAR may improve extraction of directional skill signals and model selection, but practical deployment still requires independent validation.
cards.titleEn: CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that symmetric losses such as mean squared error and mean absolute error are misaligned with the economics of financial log-return prediction, because the conditional mean is close to zero, making a constant zero forecast near-optimal. The authors propose the CZAR loss, a piecewise quadratic loss satisfying convexity, directional asymmetry, near-linear penalization, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive evaluation floor. Under a Gaussian linear model, the directional accuracy required for symmetric losses to beat the zero predictor rises sharply with prediction noise, whereas the threshold under CZAR evaluation remains near 50%; this advantage persists under heavy-tailed distributions and in a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns.
cards.limitationsEn: The claimed advantages rest mainly on theoretical derivations under a Gaussian linear prediction model, idealized tests, simulations with heavy-tailed distributions, and a LightGBM experiment on a single asset (intraday BTC log-returns); no large-scale empirical evidence across markets, frequencies, or models is provided. The hyperparameters of CZAR, though simplifiable, still require selection, and robustness under real trading costs, non-stationarity, and out-of-sample performance is not verified. Changes in evaluation metrics may affect model rankings, but direct links to portfolio construction or risk management are not discussed.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为金融收益预测提供了与经济目标更一致的目标函数，有助于减少模型向零收缩的偏差，并在评估中避免零预测因对称损失而获得虚高排名。对量化研究而言，CZAR可能改善方向性技能信号的提取和模型选择，但实际部署仍需独立验证。
keyPoints: 对称损失因金融对数收益条件均值接近零而惩罚具有真实但噪声方向技能的模型，训练中预测收缩、评估中零预测易占优。
CZAR是分段二次损失，在固定真实值下对预测凸，具有闭式梯度和Hessian，适合梯度提升库自定义目标，四个超参数通过相关默认值简化为单一选择。
高斯线性模型下对称损失的盈亏平衡方向准确率随预测噪声急剧上升，而CZAR评估下该阈值接近50%，且在重尾收益分布和BTC日内LightGBM实验中优势持续。
cards.originalTitle: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
cards.title: CZAR损失函数：面向金融对数收益预测的定制目标函数
cards.summary: 论文指出均方误差和平均绝对误差等对称损失在金融对数收益预测中与经济学目标错位，因为条件均值接近零使常数零预测近似最优。作者提出CZAR损失，一种满足凸性、方向不对称、近线性惩罚、大误差发散和自适应评估下限的分段二次损失。高斯线性模型下，对称损失跑赢零预测所需的方向准确率随预测噪声急剧上升，而CZAR评估下该阈值接近50%；在重尾分布和LightGBM的BTC日内实验中优势持续。
cards.descriptionEn: The paper introduces the CZAR loss to address the bias of symmetric losses toward zero forecasts caused by the near-zero conditional mean of financial log-returns. The new loss features convexity, directional asymmetry, near-linear penalization, and an adaptive loss floor; theory shows the directional accuracy needed to beat the zero predictor under CZAR evaluation is near 50%, and a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC data reduces zero-returns bias and improves directional a
cards.limitations: 论文所述优势主要基于高斯线性预测模型的理论推导、理想化测试、重尾分布模拟以及单一资产（BTC日内对数收益）的LightGBM实验，未提供跨市场、跨频率或跨模型的大规模实证；CZAR的超参数虽可简化但仍需选择，其在实际交易成本、非平稳性和样本外表现下的稳健性未被验证；评估指标变化可能影响模型排名，但未讨论与投资组合构建或风险管理的直接关联。
cards.description: 论文提出CZAR损失，针对金融对数收益条件均值接近零导致对称损失偏向零预测的问题。新损失具备凸性、方向不对称、近线性惩罚和自适应损失下限，理论显示其评估下跑赢零预测所需方向准确率接近50%，并在BTC日内数据上降低零收益偏差、提升大幅收益方向准确率。

keyPointsEn: Built on Cloudflare Workers, leveraging edge computing capabilities.
Provides an integrated workspace for document creation, app building, and agent execution.
Emphasizes using company context and systems to enhance agent situational awareness.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If mature, this workspace could help developers quickly build agent applications linked to internal company data and tools, reducing the burden of building infrastructure from scratch and promoting AI tool adoption in business scenarios.
cards.titleEn: Cloudflare Launches Agent Workspace Operating System
cards.summaryEn: Fact: Cloudflare open-sourced the cloudflare-os repository on GitHub, positioned as a Workers-based agent workspace supporting document creation, app building, and agent execution. Opinion: The project highlights integration with company context and systems, potentially lowering the barrier for enterprise agent application development.
cards.limitationsEn: Current information only comes from the repository description, lacking technical details, performance data, practical usability assessment, and key information such as licensing. Its functional completeness and stability have not been third-party verified; specific capabilities should be based on official documentation or code.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作区若成熟，可能帮助开发者快速搭建与企业内部数据和工具联动的智能体应用，减少从零构建基础设施的负担，并推动 AI 工具在业务场景中的落地。
keyPoints: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建，利用边缘计算能力。
提供文档创建、应用构建和智能体运行的一体化工作区。
强调使用公司上下文和系统，提升智能体的情境感知。

keyPointsEn: The roundup is a collection of titles and blurbs for recent quant links on Quantocracy.
A central item tests Buffett's contrarian advice to be greedy when others are fearful.
The test involves CNN's Fear & Greed Index as a sentiment measure.
cards.whyItMattersEn: If contrarian strategies can be systematically validated with sentiment indicators, it helps assess whether extreme sentiment readings carry tradable quantitative meaning; however, this roundup is only a link index, so its value depends on the original articles' methods and results.
